    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}

    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');

    throw new Error('Argument "trim" must be a boolean');

}

          mode: { type: 'string', enum: MODES, description: 'The transformation mode.' },
          trim: { type: 'boolean', default: true, description: 'Whether to trim surrounding whitespace before transforming. Defaults to true.' },

        required: ['text', 'mode'],
        additionalProperties: false,
      },
    },
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'text_transform') {

  const { text, mode } = args;
  const trim = args.trim === undefined ? true : args.trim;

  if (trim) {

  if (mode === 'uppercase') {
    value = value.toUpperCase();
  } else if (mode === 'lowercase') {
    value = value.toLowerCase();
  } else if (mode === 'slug') {
    value = slugify(value);
  }
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: value }],
  };
}
